requirements.text: Update the inventory records to reflect the decommissioning of the broken unit
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM installed_product WHERE installed_product_id = 21 AND account_id = 4 AND product_id = 152 AND serial_number = 'P152-537224-3992' AND status = 'retired' AND location_id = 809
assumptions: the unit with serial P152-537224-3992 is installed product 21 (Globex, account 4; product 152; location 809), in repair status on the seed
decommissioning a complete write-off is status retired
account, product, serial and location are the unit's seed values, kept from the benchmark check; they must not change

requirements.text: the induction of the replacement (Serial: P152-648335-99)
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM installed_product WHERE installed_product_id = 301 AND account_id = 4 AND product_id = 152 AND serial_number = 'P152-648335-99' AND status = 'in_use' AND location_id = 809
assumptions: installed_product_id 301: id assumed next in sequence
a fresh Variant 20 of Palo Alto Networks PA-3220 is product 152 (active)
status in_use: the replacement is inducted into service in place of the broken unit, and the policy requires installed products to be in_use
location 809 (Globex Hq - Sydney), the broken unit's site: implied by the request ('swapping it'), not stated; kept from the benchmark check

requirements.text: Open a documentation case for this activity from web and assign it to Tabitha (tabitha.bullock@servicenow.com)
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1233 AND account_id = 4 AND contact_id = 2 AND product_id = 152 AND installed_product_id = 301 AND channel = 'web' AND priority = 'moderate' AND state = 'new' AND assigned_to = 3 AND assignment_group_id IS NULL AND escalation = 0 AND reopen_count = 0
assumptions: case_id 1233: id assumed next in sequence
priority not stated; the policy's default is moderate
state new: the policy's default for a registered case
installed product 301 (the replacement): the case documents the swap, and the policy forbids attaching the retired unit 21 to a new case
contact 2 (Globex's primary contact) kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy
assignment_group_id NULL kept from the benchmark check; the request names a user and no group
escalation 0 and reopen_count 0 are a new case's defaults, kept from the benchmark check

documentation_case_creation.evidence: number = 'CS-0001233' and closed_on IS NULL test columns the server keeps (the case number is generated on creation, closed_on is set only on closure), so those two predicates are dropped; every other cell is carried unchanged

active_entitlement_validation.evidence: entitlement 32 (account 4, product 152, active, premium, on active contract 10, valid to 2028-02-15) exists on the seed and no listed tool writes the entitlement table; the check reads a fact the agent only consults

notes:
Four checks are conjunctions over cells the requirements already carry: the pair validation (both units at account 4, product 152, location 809, and exactly two such units, so registering the replacement twice would fail it), the case-to-replacement linkage and the no-retired-or-repair check (case 1233 on unit 301, which is in_use), and the active-agent check (case 1233 assigned to user 3, whose email, role and active flag are seed facts). Each is listed in the source of every requirement that carries one of its parts.
short_description is not tested: the request says only 'documentation case' and the policy's template (Product: Palo Alto Networks PA-3220 Variant 20, Issue: is not working as expected.) is the only thing fixing it, which the benchmark does not test.
The new unit's warranty_end is not fixed by the request and is not tested.
Case 78 (in_progress) still points at the retired unit; the request does not ask to move it, so it is not tested.
